action_seed_rule: first four bytes of SHA256(v2-final-ds-v1:{label}:{motif}:{base_seed}:{view}), unsigned big endian; reset Python NumPy Torch once per attack, never at phase boundary
aggregation: Equal views and action repeats within each layout; equal accepted layouts within scope; equal weight to each learner. Overall is accepted-layout weighted, not motif balanced.
baseline: HeuristicCommander() once per accepted layout/view; observed-coverage side, not best-side oracle
filter: unchanged experiments.pools.validate_base: structure plus best-of-four-side heuristic destruction in [0.25,0.85]
history: Specified after V2 cohort development results, before generating or evaluating this fresh final pool. Not preregistered before training. V1 used 11000-11199; layered_core has previously been examined, but is excluded from V2 training and development.

intervals.method: percentile bootstrap across paired learner seeds
intervals.scope: conditional on fixed accepted layouts, eight views and three action labels; unadjusted secondary intervals

limitations: Frozen simulator including inaccessible-target movement limitation; no reachable-target fallback.
Heuristic-filtered candidate distribution; final results do not represent arbitrary custom bases.
Fresh seeds are not proof of completely novel geometry. The preflight checks recorded pools and evaluation contracts for seed reuse.
Do not attribute a V2-final versus V1-final difference solely to longer training: test layouts and acting recipe differ.
primary_comparison: PA minus P across ten matched learner seeds on all accepted layouts
primary_metric: mean fraction of total building value destroyed
selection: All twenty approved final checkpoints; no best checkpoint or learner selection. No tuning after final results.
